senses.gloss: com., pl. אִסְטְכִיוַיָּא (אִסְטְכִיוָן Ar.) (Ispe. noun of שכי, סכי; cmp. b. h. שְׂכִיָּה, מַשְׂכִּית) prop. embroidered figures; hence embroidered girdle.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:12">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:7">Gen. III, 7</cite>) various girdles <he>סדינים</he>, <he>א׳ גליון</he> (Var. <he>גליונים</he>, Ar. ed. Koh. <he>גולין</he>) embroidered girdles (or girdle), wrapping belts, and white linen belts; v. <cite ref="C00941"><he>גִּלְיוֹן</he></cite> 3). [Pl. in sing. sense, v. <cite ref="C00874"><he>גִּלְגַּלִּין</he></cite>.]
